Example season interviews for a creel survey

Source: R/data.R
example_season_interviews.Rd

Access-point interviews from the 36 sampled days in example_season_calendar, one row per angling party. Most parties had finished fishing (complete trips); about a quarter were still fishing when interviewed (incomplete trips). Most parties caught nothing, as on most real fisheries.

Usage

example_season_interviews

Format

A data frame with 231 rows and 8 columns:

date

Interview date (Date class), a sampled day in the calendar

day_type

Day type stratum: "weekday" or "weekend"

interview_id

Integer interview identifier, 1 to 231

trip_status

"complete" or "incomplete"

hours_fished

Hours the party had fished when interviewed: the whole trip if complete, the time so far if incomplete

n_anglers

Integer number of anglers in the party

catch_total

Integer fish caught by the party, kept and released

catch_kept

Integer fish kept (harvest), never more than catch_total

Source

Simulated with simulate_creel_data() and a fixed seed; see data-raw/example_season.R in the package source.

See also

example_season_calendar, example_season_counts

Other "Example Datasets": creel_counts_toy, creel_interviews_toy, example_aerial_counts, example_aerial_glmm_counts, example_aerial_interviews, example_ages, example_calendar, example_camera_counts, example_camera_interviews, example_camera_timestamps, example_catch, example_counts, example_ice_interviews, example_ice_sampling_frame, example_interviews, example_lengths, example_roving_interviews, example_season_calendar, example_season_counts, example_sections_calendar, example_sections_counts, example_sections_interviews

Examples

data(example_season_calendar)
data(example_season_counts)
data(example_season_interviews)

design <- creel_design(example_season_calendar, date = date, strata = day_type)
design <- add_counts(design, example_season_counts,
  count_col = total_anglers, period_length_col = daylight_hours
)
design <- add_interviews(design, example_season_interviews,
  catch = catch_total, harvest = catch_kept, effort = hours_fished,
  trip_status = trip_status, n_anglers = n_anglers
)
#> ℹ 153 interviews have zero catch.
#>   Zero catch is usual; check it is not missing data recorded as 0.
#> ℹ Added 231 interviews: 172 complete (74%), 59 incomplete (26%)
estimate_total_catch(design, target = "period_total")
#> 
#> ── Creel Survey Estimates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> Method: Total Catch (Effort × CPUE)
#> Variance: Taylor linearization
#> Confidence level: 95%
#> Effort target: period_total
#> Unit: fish
#> 
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   estimate    se ci_lower ci_upper     n
#>      <dbl> <dbl>    <dbl>    <dbl> <int>
#> 1    2230.  482.    1278.    3183.   172
